practicals.title: Experiment 1
content: Draw sketches of load bearing structure and framed structure and
identify their components

practicals.title: Experiment 2
content: Draw sketches of shallow foundations such as stepped footing, wall
footing and isolated column footing

practicals.title: Experiment 3
content: Draw sketches of shallow foundations such as combined footing
raft foundation and grillage foundation

practicals.title: Experiment 4
content: Draw sketches of deep foundations such as pile foundation, well
foundation and caisson

practicals.title: Experiment 5
content: Draw sketches of types of stone masonry such as rubble masonry
and ashlar masonry

practicals.title: Experiment 6
content: Draw sketches of bonds in brick masonry such as header bond
stretcher bond, English bond and Flemish bond

practicals.title: Experiment 7
content: Draw sketches of various brick walls using different brick
dimensions and thicknesses

practicals.title: Experiment 8
content: Draw sketches of tools required for construction of stone masonry
and brick masonry

practicals.title: Experiment 9
content: Draw sketches of different types of formwork used in construction

practicals.title: Experiment 10
content: Draw sketches of different types of scaffolding used in construction

practicals.title: Experiment 11
content: Draw sketches of excavation and earth moving equipment used in
construction

practicals.title: Experiment 12
content: Draw sketches of compacting equipment used in construction

practicals.title: Experiment 13
content: Draw sketches of hoisting equipment used in construction

practicals.title: Experiment 14
content: Prepare a report on safety measures and recent trends in the
construction field
Total Hours 28
